transcript: "Profiterole Frittata" is the twelfth track on the album Longmont Potion Castle 11, released in 2014 on D.U. Records.
A commissioned call, it is "one of [the] least favorite tracks" of Longmont Potion Castle:

There was a guy who commissioned me to call his girlfriend. He’s a big listener to Longmont—loves it. And, uh… to equal proportion his girlfriend hates it—hates me. Never met me but hates me… just so much! So he actually commissioned me to call her. It’s a track called “Profiterole Frittata” … It’s one of my least favorite tracks. I just fills me with— gosh, I don’t know! She’s just rude! She’s an awful chick. I don’t know what her problem is.
